limitations: PP and TG both reset before execution. P/PP + G/TG sums separate empty-history microbench phases; it is NOT decode after that prompt or request/server latency. Load/startup are excluded.
mx n_ctx=max(512,P,G); llmx reach=max(P,G). Allocated KV layouts need not match. Identical token-stream seeds: PP12345 and TG777. F32 K/V; llmx auto F16 arithmetic; ubatch512; threads4.
Four matched blocks per cell; no measured layout noise band, both-phase floor verdict, or automatic acceptance/rejection.

All warmups and samples retained. Activity flags describe overlapping monitor intervals, not proven causation. Whole-disk counters are not process-attributed. Short-lived processes may escape sampling; unavailable counters are unknown, not zero.

activity.raw_monitor_limitations: Short-lived processes between samples may be missed; disappeared/new and inaccessible processes are retained as coverage limits. Unavailable GPU counters are not zero.

source_runtime: Retained direct-grid-v4; v9/v10 experiments not adopted.

assessment.decision: Retain v4 for remaining landing qualification under the existing whole-workload performance-tradeoff rule; no universal or both-phase mx floor pass is claimed.
assessment.basis: Across all three measured cells, PP gains 63.72 to 68.63 percent and TG loses 4.06 to 5.92 percent. The large prefill gain is worthwhile for prompt-heavy use; decode-heavy use has a real cost, retained as a follow-up.
assessment.counterexample: P128/G256 sums of independent phase times are 4.06 percent longer. P512/G128 is 5.86 percent shorter and P4096/G256 is 23.50 percent shorter. All paired signs agree; these are not server/request latencies.
assessment.remaining: Focused split qualification, unchanged-format identity/timing, integration and hosted checks remain. No correctness limit or required check is waived.

benchmark_semantics.history: Both adapters reset independently before PP and TG; TG is not run after the named prompt. Phase sums are synthetic, not request latency.
benchmark_semantics.tokens: Both use LCG 1664525/1013904223 with PP seed12345 and TG seed777, IDs modulo min(1000,vocab).
benchmark_semantics.context: mx allocates max(512,P,G), llmx reach=max(P,G); both use F32KV, but allocated KV layouts may differ.
benchmark_semantics.adapter: Pinned mx Vulkan wrapper.cpp inspected directly alongside llmx src/cli/main.cpp:cmd_bench_model.
